name: Undb
title: undb.io
shortDescription: Undb is a private first open source No-code platform and Backend as a Service (BaaS) that you can host yourself. It is designed for developers and businesses seeking to build applications quickly using a variety of view options like grid, kanban, and calendar. Example use case: A startup could use Undb to manage their sales pipeline and customer relationships efficiently without relying on third-party services.
pros: Host on your own server for privacy
